products.title: UnReflectAnything
products.subtitle: RGB-only highlight removal by rendering synthetic specular supervision
products.description: RGB-only highlight removal by rendering synthetic specular supervision.

details.body:
UnReflect Anything is an RGB-only method that removes specular highlights from arbitrary scenes. Instead of relying on multi-view captures or polarization, we render synthetic supervision — pairs of clean and highlighted images — by composing physically-plausible specular layers on top of real images, then train a network to invert the process.

The result is a fast, single-image pipeline that transfers cleanly to surgical, automotive and macro photography domains, where traditional dichromatic methods break down.
highlights: Single-image input — no multi-view or polarization required
Synthetic supervision pipeline generalizes across domains
Real-time inference on a single consumer GPU

products.title: STEVE
products.subtitle: Augmented training curriculum for surgical robotics
products.description: Implementation and assessment of an augmented training curriculum for surgical robotics.

details.body: STEVE pairs the da Vinci Research Kit with a structured AR curriculum that progressively scaffolds operator skill — from basic spatial awareness to bimanual tasks under cognitive load. We measured technical and non-technical skill gains across cohorts and showed that augmented feedback shortens the learning curve.
highlights: AR curriculum integrated with the da Vinci Research Kit
Validated across multiple operator cohorts at ICRA 2024

products.title: SCALE-EM
products.subtitle: Self-supervised embeddings for endoscopic matching
products.description: Self-Supervised Contrastive Embedding Adaptation for Endoscopic Image Matching.

details.body: SCALE-EM adapts visual foundation embeddings to the endoscopic domain using a contrastive scheme tailored to surgical video. Without labels, the model learns local descriptors that survive non-rigid tissue deformation and specular interference — unlocking robust frame-to-frame matching for downstream SLAM and registration.

products.title: muVES
products.subtitle: 3D analysis of microvasculature on-chip
products.description: A three-dimensional method for morphological analysis and flow velocity estimation in microvasculature on-a-chip.

details.body: μVES is an open pipeline for quantifying micro-vessel morphology and flow inside organs-on-chip. It reconstructs the 3D vascular network from confocal stacks and extracts diameter, tortuosity and velocity — metrics that previously required manual tracing.

products.title: UnderXAI-OVIT
products.subtitle: Decision support in ovarian cancer treatment
products.description: Deep Learning for decision support in ovarian cancer treatment planning.

details.body: UnderXAI-OVIT couples a clinical-grade segmentation backbone with a counterfactual explanation module so oncologists can interrogate why the network suggests a given treatment route.

products.title: Surgical AR Review
products.subtitle: Recent advancements in AR for robotic surgery
products.description: Recent advancements in augmented reality for robotic applications: a survey.

details.body: A comprehensive survey covering display modalities, registration pipelines and human-factors evidence for AR in robotic surgery. Written as a primer for engineers entering the field.

products.title: GroundControl
products.subtitle: Beautiful system monitoring in your terminal
products.description: Rich visualization and monitoring of system metrics in the terminal.

details.body: GroundControl is a Textual-based TUI that turns any terminal into a live cockpit for your machine: CPU, GPU, memory, network and disk in one glance. Built for SSH sessions where a browser is not an option.
highlights: Runs over SSH — no display server needed
Pluggable widgets and theme system. You choose what to see and how to see it!

products.title: DaSSHboard
products.subtitle: A stylish SSH dashboard for VS Code
products.description: A stylish dashboard for quickly connecting to SSH hosts with customizable settings.

details.body: DaSSHboard turns the cluttered list of SSH hosts in VS Code into a fast, visual launcher. Pin hosts, group them, and connect with a single click.

products.title: MedView
products.subtitle: NIfTI / DICOM viewer for VS Code
products.description: A medical image viewer for NIfTI and DICOM formats.

details.body: MedView lets clinicians and engineers inspect NIfTI and DICOM volumes inside VS Code — no separate viewer, no context switching. Useful when annotating or debugging medical-imaging pipelines.
